tenders.original_title: Estonia – Disposable non-chemical medical consumables and haematological consumables
tenders.english_summary: This is a procurement tender issued by Tartu University Hospital in Estonia for disposable non-chemical medical consumables and haematological consumables. The description repeatedly refers to Annex 1 for detailed specifications, exclusion grounds, and qualification requirements.
tenders.what_they_want: Disposable non-chemical medical consumables and haematological consumables. Specific product details, models, and brands are referenced in Annex 1 of the tender documents.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Exclusion grounds and qualification conditions are specified in Annex 1 of the tender documentation (referenced repeatedly as "Kõrvaldamise alused ja kvalifitseerimistingimused: Vaata hanke alusdokumentidest").

tenders.buyer_name: Szpital Miejski w Gliwicach Sp. z o.o.
tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply, installation, and commissioning of medical imaging equipment for a municipal hospital in Gliwice, Poland. The scope includes delivery, installation, staff training on operation and maintenance, and provision of required documentation. The equipment must be new, manufactured in 2025 or later, and comply with Polish medical device and radiation safety regulations.
tenders.what_they_want: Medical imaging equipment (specific type not detailed in notice). Requirements include: new equipment manufactured no earlier than 2025, factory-packed, free from defects, compliant with medical device regulations and atomic law. Delivery, installation, commissioning, staff training for operation/maintenance/cleaning/disinfection, and training for diagnostic imaging personnel on conducting examinations. Technical parameters referenced in Attachment 2 (not provided).
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Bidders must possess and provide documents confirming compliance with the Act on Medical Devices (April 7, 2022), Atomic Law Act (November 29, 2000), and Minister of Health Regulation on safe use of ionizing radiation (January 11, 2023). Must be able to provide documentation on demand at any time. Equivalent solutions are permitted if they meet or exceed specified technical, quality, operational, and functional parameters.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the procurement of 52 electric hospital beds with active (variable pressure) mattresses, IV stands, and patient grab bars for Pro-Medica in Ełk, Poland. The purchase is part of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan to develop long-term care infrastructure at the district level. All equipment must be brand new, manufactured in 2025 or 2026, and comply with medical device regulations and the "Do No Significant Harm" (DNSH) principle.
tenders.what_they_want: 52 electric hospital beds, each equipped with: active mattress (variable pressure type), IV drip stand, and patient grab bar with handle. Equipment must be brand new, manufactured in 2025 or 2026, non-demonstration units, ready for use after installation.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Bidders must supply medical devices that meet Polish legal requirements for market placement and use according to the Medical Devices Act of April 7, 2022 (Journal of Laws 2024, item 1620 as amended). Products must comply with EU Regulation 2020/852 DNSH principle ("Do No Significant Harm"). All minimum requirements specified in Attachment 4 must be met.

tenders.buyer_name: Samodzielny Publiczny Zespół Opieki Zdrowotnej w Kolbuszowej
tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for medical optical equipment by a Polish healthcare facility. The package includes 6 ureteroscopes (URS optics), 2 resectoscopes 26 FR, and 2 resectoscopes 28 FR. Bidders must submit offers for the complete package and confirm compliance with EU environmental standards.
tenders.what_they_want: Ureteroscope (URS) optics - 6 pieces; Resectoscope 26 FR - 2 pieces; Resectoscope 28 FR - 2 pieces
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Bidders must submit offers for the complete package (all items in the package). Must provide declaration in offer form confirming equipment does not violate "do no significant harm" principle for environmental objectives per EU Regulation 2020/852 Article 17.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance of a 1.5 Tesla nuclear magnetic resonance (MRI) imaging system including a Faraday cage (with finishing work), cooling system, and staff training. The contract execution is subject to approval of new accreditation and Board of Directors decision.
tenders.what_they_want: 1.5 Tesla nuclear magnetic resonance (MRI) imaging equipment with Faraday cage included (including cage finishing work), machine cooling system, installation, commissioning, maintenance services, and staff training.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Bidder must provide all approvals related to installation and start-up of the MRI and Faraday cage from accredited/approved organizations.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of endoscopic bronchoscopy equipment with accessories for the Motol Oncology Center at Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka hospital in the Czech Republic. The contract includes installation, commissioning, staff training, and warranty/post-warranty service.
tenders.what_they_want: Endoscopic bronchoscopy equipment with accessories, including installation and commissioning with functionality verification and prescribed tests, staff training/instruction on the equipment, and warranty and post-warranty service provision.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Service personnel must be authorized according to § 41 of Act No. 375/2022 Coll. on medical devices for conducting staff training. Service technicians must hold manufacturer certification for training according to §§ 44-46 of Act No. 375/2022 Coll. on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices.

tenders.original_title: Czechia – Echo, ultrasound and doppler imaging equipment
tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka in Czechia is procuring multiple ultrasound devices for their Motol Oncology Center, including ultrasound equipment for brachytherapy (MAMO) and general oncology use (KZM). The procurement includes installation, staff training, and warranty/post-warranty service.
tenders.what_they_want: Multiple ultrasound devices including: (1) Ultrasound for KZM with accessories, (2) MAMO ultrasound for brachytherapy with accessories, (3) MAMO ultrasound for KZM with accessories. Each device requires installation, commissioning, functionality verification, all prescribed tests, staff training/instruction, and warranty plus post-warranty service performed by manufacturer-certified technicians.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Service personnel must be authorized according to § 41 of Act No. 375/2022 Coll. on Medical Devices. Service technicians must hold manufacturer certification for training according to § 44-46 of Act No. 375/2022 Coll.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of endoscopic equipment for urology including accessories for the Motol Oncology Center at the University Hospital Motol and Homolka. The contract includes installation, commissioning, staff training, and warranty/post-warranty service of the equipment.
tenders.what_they_want: Endoscopic equipment for urology including accessories. The contract also requires installation and commissioning of the device including functionality verification and all prescribed tests, staff training/instruction by authorized personnel, and warranty and post-warranty service by certified technicians.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Service technicians must hold manufacturer certification for training as per sections 44-46 of Act No. 375/2022 Sb. Training personnel must be authorized according to section 41 of Act No. 375/2022 Sb. on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of gastroenterology endoscopic equipment including accessories for the Motol Oncology Center at Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka hospital. The contract includes installation, commissioning, staff training, and warranty/post-warranty service of the equipment.
tenders.what_they_want: Gastroenterology endoscopic equipment with accessories. Installation and commissioning including functionality verification and prescribed tests. Staff training/instruction conducted by authorized personnel according to Law No. 375/2022 Sb. on medical devices. Warranty and post-warranty service by certified technicians.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Service providers must employ personnel authorized under Section 41 of Law No. 375/2022 Sb. for medical device training. Service technicians must hold manufacturer certification for servicing according to Sections 44-46 of Law No. 375/2022 Sb. on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of a mammography X-ray device including accessories and a planning system for the Motol Oncology Center at the Motol and Homolka Teaching Hospital. The scope includes installation, commissioning, staff training, and warranty/post-warranty servicing.
tenders.what_they_want: Mammography X-ray device (mamografický RTG) with accessories and planning system for oncology center use. Installation, commissioning with functional verification and required tests. Staff training and warranty/post-warranty maintenance services included.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Training must be conducted by a person authorized under Section 41 of Act No. 375/2022 Coll. on Medical Devices. Servicing must be performed by personnel authorized and certified by the manufacturer for servicing the equipment.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the successive supply of an endoscopic suturing system and related consumables to the Medical University of Warsaw. The procurement includes disposable endoscopic suture devices, polypropylene sutures, instruments, and endoscopic spiral graspers.
tenders.what_they_want: 60 pieces of disposable endoscopic suturing systems; 300 pieces of polypropylene sutures; 300 pieces of instruments/tools; 60 pieces of endoscopic spiral graspers. Specific technical requirements are detailed in the price-assortment form (Attachment 2).
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Offered products must be medical devices approved for trade and use in Poland in accordance with the Act of 07.04.2022 on medical devices (Journal of Laws 2022, item 974 as amended) and Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and Council dated 05.04.2017 (MDR) as amended.

tenders.original_title: Czechia – Sterilisation, disinfection and hygiene devices
tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of endoscope disinfection equipment and drying cabinets (both pass-through and non-pass-through types) for Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka hospital in Czechia. The procurement includes installation, staff training, commissioning, and warranty/post-warranty service for all equipment.
tenders.what_they_want: Pass-through endoscope disinfectors, non-pass-through endoscope disinfectors, non-pass-through drying cabinets, and pass-through drying cabinets. Each item includes: installation and commissioning with functionality verification and prescribed tests; staff training/instruction; warranty and post-warranty service.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Service technicians must hold manufacturer certificates for training per sections 44-46 of Act No. 375/2022 Sb. (Medical Devices Act). Training personnel must be authorized according to section 41 of Act No. 375/2022 Sb. on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices.

tenders.english_summary: This is a framework tender for the supply of microscopy and imaging equipment for Scottish higher education institutions. The procurement covers a wide range of optical microscopes from low-end teaching equipment (under £10,000) to high-end research systems (over £10,000), including advanced laser microscopy, super resolution systems, cameras, detectors, light sources, and high-content screening equipment.
tenders.what_they_want: Low-end optical microscopes (under £10,000 excl. VAT) including compound microscopes (upright/inverted with optional fluorescence and cameras), stereo/zoom microscopes, and gel documentation systems. High-end optical microscopes (over £10,000 excl. VAT) including compound microscopes, stereo/zoom microscopes, label-free holographic microscopes, automated live cell microscopes, and slide scanners. Advanced laser microscopy systems (confocal, spinning disc, TIRF, light sheet, multi-photon). Super resolution microscopy equipment (STED, GSD, SPDMphymod). FLIM/FRET systems and structured illumination systems. Specialist cameras and detectors (PMTs, FLIM detectors). Light sources (incandescent lamps, halogen bulbs, arc lamps, LED light sources, lasers). High-content screening systems with associated software and automatic sample handling.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Economic operators may be excluded if they are in any of the situations referred to in regulation 58 of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015 (mandatory and discretionary grounds for exclusion).

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for the supply of janitorial and cleaning products across Scotland, divided into two lots: Lot 1 covers general janitorial/cleaning products and materials, while Lot 2 covers single-use and reusable sanitary products with delivery to multiple sites including direct-to-student options.
tenders.what_they_want: Lot 1 - Range of janitorial and cleaning products and associated materials and services (minimum 170 line items from Core Product List Section A). Lot 2 - Single use and reusable sanitary products and associated support services (minimum 22 line items from Core Product List Section A).
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Contractors must be able to price and supply minimum 71.75% (170 line items) of Core Product List for Lot 1, and minimum 64.71% (22 line items) for Lot 2. Economic operators may be excluded if they fall under situations referred to in regulation 58 of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015.

tenders.buyer_name: The Common Services Agency (more commonly known as NHS National Services Scotland) (NSS)
tenders.english_summary: NHS National Services Scotland is procuring a framework agreement for various types of central venous catheters and related vascular access devices. This includes coated and non-coated CVCs, PICC lines, arterial lines, dialysis catheters, stabilisation devices, implantable ports, and associated accessories for administering medication, fluids, and blood sampling across adult and paediatric populations.
tenders.what_they_want: Coated Central Venous Catheters (CVC), Non-Coated Central Venous Catheters, Paediatric Central Venous Catheters, Midline Catheters, Skin Tunnelling Catheters, PICC Lines (Antimicrobial), PICC Lines (Non-Coated), Seldinger Arterial Lines, Non-Seldinger Arterial Cannulas, IV Flush Saline Pre-filled Syringes, Stabilisation Devices, Dialysis Central Venous Catheters, Implantable Ports, Central Venous Catheter Insertion Packs, Accessories (unscored lot), and Innovation products (unscored lot). No specific model numbers or brands mentioned.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: Multiple scored lots (Lots 1-14) and unscored lots (Accessories, Innovation, Insertion Packs). Suppliers must meet all mandatory requirements and tender against scored lots to be eligible for unscored lots. Specific price/quality weightings not mentioned.

tenders.original_title: NHS Grampian Radiotherapy TPS, OMS and Archive Replacement
tenders.english_summary: NHS Grampian seeks to replace end-of-life radiotherapy equipment at Aberdeen Cancer Centre, including a Treatment Planning System, Oncology Information Management System, and Radiotherapy Archive under Scotland's Capital Equipment Replacement Programme. The contract will be awarded to a single prime contractor responsible for turnkey delivery of all systems and services.
tenders.what_they_want: One (1) Treatment Planning System (TPS), one (1) Oncology Information Management System (OMS), and one (1) Radiotherapy Archive for installation at Aberdeen Cancer Centre, Aberdeen Royal Infirmary. Turnkey implementation including all associated services and installation required.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Contractors must be able to act as Prime Contractor with full responsibility for all products and services. Site visit(s) to Aberdeen Cancer Centre required. Must be capable of managing sub-contracting or collaborative arrangements with other suppliers as needed.

tenders.original_title: Purchase of Orthopaedic Power Tools, Bone Cement & Mixers, Pulse Lavage & Tourniquets
tenders.buyer_name: The Common Services Agency (more commonly known as Public Services Delivery Scotland) (PSD Scotland)
tenders.english_summary: This is a framework tender for orthopaedic surgical equipment across NHS Scotland, covering power tools (both general and precision), bone cement and mixing systems, pulse lavage irrigation systems, and tourniquet cuffs with accessories. The procurement is organized into multiple lots for use in acute orthopaedic surgical procedures by trained NHS personnel.
tenders.what_they_want: Orthopaedic surgical power tools including bone saws, dermatomes, cutters, drills, drivers, and handpieces (both large/small bone and precision/specialist tools for spinal/neuro/CMF/ENT procedures); consumables and accessories for power tools; bone cement and bone cement mixing systems; bone cement accessories; pulse lavage irrigation systems; tourniquet cuffs (disposable, reusable, and semi-reusable); tourniquet cuff accessories; service and maintenance plans for all equipment.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: Multiple scored lots (Lots 1-8) and unscored lots (Lots 9-11 including service/maintenance and innovation). Specific weighting percentages not provided in the notice. Bidders must bid on at least one scored lot (1-8) to qualify for unscored lots.

tenders.buyer_name: The Common Services Agency (more commonly known as Public Services Delivery Scotland) (PSD Scotland)
tenders.english_summary: This is a framework tender for the supply of sexual health products and services to NHS Scotland. The procurement covers multiple lots including condoms, lubricants, sexual health testing products, pre-bagged sexual health kits, and value-added services to support sexual health service delivery across Scotland.
tenders.what_they_want: Lot 1: Loose condoms (standard latex, large, latex-free, extra-thin, flavoured, textured, internal condoms) and lubricants. Lot 2: Pre-bagged sexual health kits containing condoms, lubricants and other sexual health products. Lot 3: Sexual health and pregnancy testing products (pregnancy tests, HIV tests, syphilis tests, combination testing products). Lot 4: Added value services (educational resources, awareness campaigns, training materials, patient information, health promotion initiatives). Lot 5: Innovative products, services and solutions (new product developments, technological advancements, service enhancements, packaging innovations, environmental improvements).
tenders.evaluation_criteria: Lots 1 and 2 evaluated together as combined requirement - Commercial 30% for Lot 1, Commercial 30% for Lot 2, Combined total 60%. Multi-supplier ranked and scored. Tenderers ranked based on combined evaluated score across Lots 1 and 2. Lot 3 is multi-supplier unranked award evaluated independently. Lots 4 and 5 are unranked and unscored - suppliers awarded on Lots 1, 2 and/or 3 automatically awarded places on Lots 4 and 5.

tenders.english_summary: This is a public procurement tender for continuous supply of various specialized catheters to the 1st Department of Internal Cardiology-Angiology at University Hospital Hradec Králové in the Czech Republic over a 4-year period. The tender covers four types of catheters: thromboaspiration catheters, guide catheter extensions, low-profile microcatheters for chronic total occlusions (CTO), and standard microcatheters for chronic total occlusions.
tenders.what_they_want: Thromboaspiration catheters; guide catheter extensions; low-profile microcatheters for use in chronic total occlusions (CTO); standard microcatheters for chronic total occlusions (CTO). All items are for continuous supply over a 4-year period.

tenders.english_summary: The German Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support is procuring diagnostic ultrasound devices for military use.

tenders.title: Integrated Children's Occupational Therapy Service
tenders.description:
Delivering interventions that support children take part in everyday activities; ensuring they can care for themselves, undertake productive occupations (e.g., writing, learning), play, and have fun. The service will also equip parents/carers, and professionals with the tools and knowledge to support children with illnesses or Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). The IPH is a shared service arrangement, whereby a number of local authorities have pooled their procurement of community equipment in to a single shared arrangement whereby Croydon Council acts as lead contracting authority procuring the Goods for and on behalf of itself and its Local Authority partners. This pooled requirement includes the community equipment that the Council and its local authority partners require as a result of performing health functions delegated to them by NHS bodies as part of their integrated commissioning arrangements.

The DPS will remain open and valid from the start date of 28th September 2016 for a period of seven years, with the ability to extend the operation of the DPS for a further three years, to 31st October 2026.

tenders.title: ASC23043 - Positive Behaviour Support Supported Living Services in Herefordshire & Worcestershire DPS
tenders.description:
UPDATE MONDAY 23 SEPTEMBER 2024: PLEASE NOTE THIS DPS IS NOW OPEN TO NEW APPLICATIONS.
       
      The ASC23043 - Positive Behaviour Support Supported Living Services in Herefordshire & Worcestershire DPS (Dynamic Purchasing System) is now open to new applications until the end of the DPS term, however as stated in the tender documents evaluation will take place in rounds which will be advertised through In-Tend.       Worcestershire County Council ('the Council') and the NHS Worcestershire and Herefordshire Integrated Care Board ('ICB'), together the Participating Authorities are establishing a joint Dynamic Purchasing System ('the DPS') for the provision of Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) Supported Living Services in Herefordshire and Worcestershire and seek applications from suitably experienced, qualified and appropriately accredited Suppliers who wish to pre-qualify for this Service.

Any Supplier who meets and passes Stage 1 and 2, will be admitted on to the DPS and will be invited to participate in future opportunities to be known as Mini Competitions (generally for scheme/cluster placements) or Referrals (for individual placements) (Stage 3), which will be advertised as explained in Appendix 2 - DPS agreement.
      
      There are no maximum number of suppliers.
      Suppliers have the option to apply to join the DPS at any time, however, the evaluation may take place in periodic 'rounds' to be determined by the Commissioner.
      
      Your application needs to be submitted by 13th June 2024, 4pm to be considered for Round 1.

The Council will assess new applications periodically through Rounds advertised on the Council's procurement portal (In-Tend).

tenders.title: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS)
tenders.description:
North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust has created a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) and invites applications from suitably experienced organisations who wish to be considered for selection to qualify for the provision of Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS).

The purpose of issuing a new Contract Notice is to Inform the market of the re-opening of the DPS for qualification - previous FTS notice reference 2022/S 000-017401.

The DPS provides for a full range of different Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services covering the areas of North Staffordshire and Stoke on Trent. The DPS offers different delivery modalities including face to face, digital and a blended approach.

This DPS service specification (Stage 1) seeks to provide an overview of the future scope of the DPS for qualification purposes. NSCHT aims to use the DPS to procure CAMHS services that will enhance existing delivery and work intuitively with the Trust's provision.

All future service specifications and provision under the DPS (Stage 2) will be expected to:
• Operate across the 0-25-year spectrum, in line with detailed specification requirements, most of the activity is expected to be within the 0-18-year spectrum.
• Take a multi-disciplinary team (MDT) approach to care and support for service users, as appropriate.
• Take a strengths-based and trauma informed approach to care/support that has an outcome focus.
• Use agreed and appropriate outcome measure tools.
• Provide timely, high quality and accessible services for children and young people and their families/carers.

Whilst there will not be specified lots, interested organisations will be required to indicate their area(s) of expertise and delivery modalities as part of the qualification process. This will form the basis of shortlisting bidders in future for specified requirements under the DPS (stage 2).

The DPS went live February 2023 and shall be live for a period of 5 years from this date. The DPS shall remain open over this period for new organisations to complete the registration process and join. Once appointed all eligible/capable providers shall be invited into requests for quotations as and when requirements become available. NHS Standard Terms and Conditions shall apply.

The DPS shall remain open to reasonable modification for innovative practices being introduced by bidders and changes within the healthcare system throughout the life of the DPS.

Applicants should register there interest to join the DPS via the MLCSU Atamis eTendering System https://atamis-1928.my.site.com/s/Welcome.

tenders.title: Mental Health Recovery
tenders.description:
The Council is seeking applications from experienced providers with the capability and capacity to deliver community mental health care and support in Rotherham.  

A review of current mental health care and support provision in Rotherham indicates the need to improve the community service model to one which offers mental health recovery support personalised social care, with increased choice and control for people living with mental ill-health.  

This new care and support model has been co-produced in partnership with people accessing services and their supporting professionals to inform the service design. 
Such services will support people to achieve independent living skills, move towards, and sustain, independent living in the communities in which they live. 

Aiming to harness the opportunities which exist in the wider care and support market, this Mental Health Recovery Flexible Purchasing System (FPS) will increase choice and improve outcomes for people living with mental ill-health in Rotherham.  

Applicants can read the Cabinet Paper dated 17th October 2022 Commissioning Mental Health Recovery Focused Community Services - Rotherham Council which sought the approval for the procurement process to establish this FPS and procure a range of community services which reflect the principles of mental health recovery model. 

The FPS will comprise of a number of separate Lots.  Each Lot will specify a community service (i.e., supported living accommodation-based services, day opportunities) with the principle of mental health recovery at its core. 

The contract end date specified is provided as an indication only , the system can continue beyond the 5 years as per the rules and subject to cabinet approval.

Applicants are advised that the indicative spend activity to be generated via the system is in the region of £4m per annum, there is no new funding for developing the initiatives proposed. The cost associated with this Flexible Purchasing System will be met within existing budgets currently set at £5.7m (2022-2023).  

Applicants are required to register with the Social Value Portal and commit to delivering Social Value additionality via all contracts awarded via the system.

Full details regarding the application process are contained within the application documentation which can be downloaded free of charge via YORtender and by searching for project ID 60316

The annual requirement for COVID-19 vaccines will be determined by DHSC and UKHSA policy following advice from the JCVI as to which cohorts should be included in an upcoming immunisation programme.

tenders.title: Health Checks DPS
tenders.description:
The NHS Health Check programme aims to reduce avoidable premature mortality by early identification and management of cardiovascular risk factors and disease in people aged between 40 and 74 years who have no previous history of CVD disease. In West Northamptonshire, 73 in every 100,000 people die prematurely before the age of 75 from cardiovascular disease.

Under the Health and Social Care Act 2012, local authorities have a legal responsibility to commission and monitor a local NHS health check programme. All local authorities must offer an NHS Health Check to 100% of their eligible population every 5 years by inviting 20% of the eligible population each year over the five-year period. In Northamptonshire, between 2024/2025 and 2028/29, 247,499 people are eligible for a NHS Health Check meaning that 49,500 people should be offered a check each year. The Councils aspiration is for 70% of Health Checks offered to be taken up, which equates to around 34,650 checks delivered each year. Office of Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID) expect that 66% of health checks offered should be taken up equating to 27,417 checks delivered each year.

Contract end date: 23rd Feb 2029
